summary: The earlier step-72 insertion path is now source-aligned. The current case matches every screen and cursor and first diverges only in RNG at zero-based step 82, when the selected corpse is removed from the carried ice box. C out_container() calls removed_from_icebox() immediately after extracting the corpse and recalculating the container weight; that helper restores absolute age, checks the saved corpse traits, updates norevive, and starts the corpse timer. The JS out_container() omits this call, so it skips start_corpse_timeout() and its first rnz draw.

source.branch: out_container() has passed its artifact, fatal-corpse and lift checks, split the selected stack if needed, extracted the selected object and recalculated the container weight. When gc.current_container is an ICE_BOX, it must call removed_from_icebox() before floor-container billing, pick_pick(), addinv(), and inventory feedback. For a corpse whose age is absolute, removed_from_icebox() computes svm.moves - obj->age, obtains OMONST traits with get_mtraits(obj, FALSE), sets norevive according to whether the saved or base species is an ice troll, then calls start_corpse_timeout().
callers: pickup.c:use_container(), traditional_loot(), and menu_loot() dispatch out_container().
pickup.c:tipcontainer() calls removed_from_icebox() for each extracted ICE_BOX content.
mon.c:meatbox() calls removed_from_icebox() before engulfing or dropping an ICE_BOX content.
muse.c:mloot_container() calls removed_from_icebox() after an ICE_BOX item passes can_carry().
dependencies: include/obj.h:age_is_relative(obj) is a macro; its six-object exemption is already implemented in in_container().
mkobj.c:get_mtraits() returns the saved corpse monster record used to distinguish a polymorphed ice troll from other corpses; mkobj-c is closed.
mkobj.c:start_corpse_timeout() consumes RNG and inserts ROT_CORPSE, REVIVE_MON, or ZOMBIFY_MON timer state; mkobj-c is closed and its current JS implementation is in timeout.js.
mkobj.c:start_glob_timeout() handles non-frozen glob shrink timers; mkobj-c is closed.
The selected out_container() caller must preserve pickup.c floor-container billing order; costly_spot() and addtobill() are existing helpers, and addtobill() is a C-void call.
